New Mexico State University

As New Mexico's first land-grant university, NMSU is dedicated to advancing knowledge and serving our communities. Our commitment to each aspect of this mission has earned recognition from the Carnegie Foundation: We are not only an RI but also a Community-Engaged institution. Our students, faculty and staff collaborate to solve real-world challenges and expand opportunity. We are a NASA Space Grant College, a Hispanic-serving institution (HSI), a minority-serving institution (MSI), and home to the state’s first Honors College delivering an accessible education that drives meaningful impact.
